in_sanskrit.name: कामना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word 'Kamana' is derived from the root word 'Kama' which means desire, longing, or love. It is often used to refer to the intense longing or craving for something, be it material or spiritual. In Hindu mythology, Kamana is also associated with the god of desire, Kamadeva, who is believed to inspire love and desire in living beings.
